plan: [ This two-stage setup is strategically equivalent to a sealed-bid second-price auction: the final price equals the second-highest sealed bid. With independent private values and risk neutrality, the dominant strategy is to bid truthfully. Overbidding risks negative surplus if I win at a price above my value; underbidding risks losing profitable wins. There’s no prior history to exploit and only one round, so no dynamic adjustments. Therefore, I will bid my value exactly to maximize expected profit. ]

[ With independent private values and a second-price outcome (winner pays the second-highest sealed bid), the weakly dominant strategy is to bid my true value. This maximizes expected profit regardless of others’ strategies: I win exactly when it’s profitable (when others’ bids are below my value) and pay the second-highest bid. Overbidding risks paying above value; underbidding risks losing profitable cases near my value. With no past-history to exploit and one round only, bid equals 34. ]

Two-stage format is equivalent to a second-price auction: the winner pays the second-highest sealed bid. Dominant strategy is truthful bidding. Overbidding risks paying above value; underbidding sacrifices positive-surplus wins. No history to exploit this round; values are redrawn each time. With value 33, set exit price equal to value. Ties resolve randomly.
